process.title: From diagnosis to launch.
process.description: A simple process to understand the right problem, design the right solution, and launch without noise.

step_1.title: Map the problem
step_1.description: We review your current website, offer, and buyer journey to find the biggest trust and conversion gaps.

step_2.title: Clarify the offer
step_2.description: We clarify the value proposition, define the page flow, and sharpen the copy before design starts.

step_3.title: Build the solution
step_3.description: We design the experience, build the product, and bake performance, SEO, and analytics into the foundation.

step_4.title: Launch and improve
step_4.description: We launch with QA, track behaviour, and keep improving the pages that matter most.

faq.title: Before we start.
faq.description: The goal is to make the next step feel clear, not high-pressure.

timeline.question: How quickly can we start?
timeline.answer: Smaller website and landing page projects can usually start quickly once the scope is clear. More complex builds need a short discovery phase first so the work stays realistic and efficient.

budget.question: Do you only work on full rebuilds?
budget.answer: No. We can help with focused improvements too, including clearer messaging, conversion fixes, design refreshes, performance work, or technical SEO.

collaboration.question: Who will I actually work with?
collaboration.answer: Directly with the senior team handling strategy, design, and development. The aim is fast communication, clear ownership, and no unnecessary layers.

support.question: Do you help after launch?
support.answer: Yes. We can continue with maintenance, SEO improvements, experiments, and iterative product work once the first version is live.

contact.title: Let’s decide what to build.
contact.description: Share your goals, timeline, and current blockers. If there is a fit, we will come back with a realistic approach for a website, app, automation, or digital improvement.
contact.details_intro: The first conversation is straightforward and practical.
contact.detail_1: We review your current site, offer, or product idea.
contact.detail_2: We identify the biggest trust, UX, and SEO gaps.
contact.detail_3: We recommend the best next step, even if it is not a full rebuild.
contact.channels_description: Email or WhatsApp both work if you want a quicker start.
contact.privacy_note: We only use your details to reply to your enquiry.
